card.name: Spots before a year, number or fact
card.fires_on: Small connecting spots such as a space, slash, hyphen, 'in', 'the' or 'it' just before a number, date or reported fact. It appears in study results and in news-style or encyclopedia-style text.

modes.label: Before a number
modes.description: A space or hyphen right before a figure in a citation, range or statistic.

modes.label: Linking word before a fact
modes.description: A short word such as in, the or it that leads into a date or a finding.
modes.example: happened offshore of Brunei<< in>> 1979. Just as

modes.label: Before a name or discovery
modes.description: A slash or verb in a news-style sentence just before a name or event.
modes.example: which was<< discovered>> in 1993 in an

card.writes: It nudges the model toward words that report news or events, such as recently, famously and announced.
card.plain: It fires on small joining marks and words just before a number, a date or a reported finding.
